summary: Engineering automated data extraction, validation pipelines, and business intelligence systems.
achievements: Pipeline Automation: Engineered and maintained automated data extraction, cleaning, and validation pipelines using Python and SQL, cutting manual processing overhead by ~40% and ensuring high schema integrity.
Exploratory Analysis (EDA): Conducted in-depth exploratory data analysis and performance tracking; created interactive Tableau and BI dashboards to visualize key operational KPIs and metrics.
Feature Preprocessing: Applied statistical normalization, outlier treatment, and data wrangling techniques to prepare structured raw inputs for analytical modeling and downstream reporting.
Schema Architecture: Partnered with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical data schemas, actionable metric dashboards, and automated daily reporting systems.
